headlines.title: JPMorgan Projects Bitcoin at 10% Annualized Returns in LTCMA Report — But a Return Range Is Not an Allocation
headlines.summary: Bitcoin has officially entered the institutional forecasting arena. In its 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions, J.P. Morgan projects a 10% compound annualized return for the asset over the next 10 to 15 years. This projection places the digital asset ahead of US large-cap equities, which are forecast at 7.5%, and gold, which sits at 5.5%.

headlines.title: Bitcoin Could Beat Stocks, Gold Over 10 Years, Says JPMorgan – But It Comes With A Volatility Warning
headlines.summary: The investment firm took Bitcoin out of its primary portfolio models due to volatile returns and uncertain correlations.

headlines.title: J.P. Morgan Stays Top of Extel’s All-America Equities Research Table
headlines.summary: NEW YORK, October 20, 2026--Extel, the leading provider of market sentiment in the financial industry, has today announced the results of its 2026 All-America Research Team survey, with J.P. Morgan maintaining their leading position by total published positions. Now in its 55th year, this independent survey determines the best-in-class sell-side research teams in the U.S. and gives buy-side investors a structured way to assess the research they use.

headlines.title: JPMorgan Bitcoin Forecast Gives BTC a Major Edge Over US Stocks
headlines.summary: JPMorgan Asset Management’s first long-term Bitcoin forecast puts its annual compounded return at 10% over 10 to 15 years, above projections for U.S. large-cap stocks, REITs, and gold. The forecast gives Bitcoin the highest modeled return among those assets.

headlines.title: The Investment Case for JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM)
headlines.summary: Diamond Hill Capital, a First Eagle Investment Management company, issued its Q3 2026 investor letter for its “Large Cap Strategy”. The letter can be downloaded here. The Strategy returned 3.18% (net of fees) in the quarter, outperforming the 2.61% return of the Russell 1000 Value Index.

description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. operates as a bank and financial holding company in the United States, rest of North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Caribbean. It operates in three segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management. The company offers deposit, investment and lending products, and cash management; mortgage origination and servicing activities; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and credit cards, payment solutions, travel services, merchant offers, lifestyle benefits, auto loans, and leases to consumers and small businesses through bank branches, ATMs, and digital and telephone banking. It also provides investment banking, market-making, financing, custody, and securities products and services; corporate strategy and structure advisory, equity and debt market capital-raising, and loan origination and syndication services; cash and derivative instruments, risk management solutions, prime brokerage, clearing, and research; and fund services, liquidity and trading services, and data solutions products for large corporations, financial institutions, merchants, start-ups, small and midsized companies, local governments, municipalities, nonprofits, and commercial real estate clients. In addition, the company offers multi-asset investment management solutions in equities, fixed income, alternatives, and money market funds to institutional clients and retail investors; retirement products and services, estate planning, lending, deposits, and investment management products to high-net-worth clients; and financial transaction processing. JPMorgan Chase & Co. was founded in 1799 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
